PraisonAIUI gives any AI model or agent a polished, responsive agent interface without writing frontend code. Every app ships with streaming Markdown, tool calls, reasoning steps, approvals, code blocks, conversation history, light and dark themes, and mobile support out of the box.

Pick whichever matches how you work — you can switch or combine them at any time. Use simple decorators in app.py to hook into any model, SDK, or custom logic: Run it with aiui run app.py. Define an AI assistant without writing Python (pip install "aiui[praisonai]" and set OPENAI_API_KEY): Run it with aiui run chat.yaml.
